Description: Verify API confirms a valid SOFT_LOCKED booking and records payment
PreRequisites: Execute SQL: INSERT INTO reservations (id, driver_id, spot_id, lot_id, start_time, end_time, status, price, lock_expires_at) VALUES (<dynamic_id>, 1, 1, 1, NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours', 'SOFT_LOCKED', 80.00, NOW() + INTERVAL '300 seconds'); Mock POST /charge to return HTTP 200 with JSON {'status': 'SUCCESS', 'txn_id': 'mock_txn_888'}
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE reservation_id = <dynamic_id> AND kind = 'BOOKING' AND status = 'PAID' -> Expected: 1
Teardown: Execute SQL: DELETE FROM payments WHERE reservation_id = <dynamic_id>; DELETE FROM reservations WHERE id = <dynamic_id>

ExpectedResult: HTTP 409 Conflict. JSON contains {'detail': 'Booking has expired. Please re-book.'}
